newsitem.title: USA: TransNet sees technical service growth.
newsitem.headline: TransNet sees technical service growth.

text.p: TransNet Corp said Tuesday its revenues from technical service and support were up 25 percent from a year earlier in the third quarter, ended March 31, and it anticipates further growth in these areas.
TransNet said revenue from hardware sales was relatively unchanged, due to product shortages that temporarily boosted back orders above normal levels.
Most of those back orders were eliminated in April, it said.
TransNet provides sales and support for personal computers, peripherals and networks, including system integration, repair/maintenance services and user training.
TransNet shares were down 1/16 at 2-7/8 in mid-morning trade.
